meta.title: PR #268: refactor: split workflow-only skills from local skills
meta.summary: Splits GitHub workflow-only skills into .github/skills while keeping .agents/skills as the local/shared skill surface, then updates workflows, installers, tests, and product docs around that boundary.

graphs.label: System overview
graphs.summary: Stable directory roles for AICodingFlow agent assets.

nodes.title: .agents/skills
nodes.summary: Repository-local and shared skills live in .agents/skills. These skills support interactive local agent work and reusable repository guidance.
details: This directory remains the stable local entry point for skills a developer can invoke while working in the repository.

nodes.title: .github/skills
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow-only skills live under .github/skills. Workflow prompts read them explicitly instead of relying on local skill discovery.
details: This separation keeps CI/workflow-only instructions out of the local default skill surface.

nodes.title: .github/workflows + scripts
nodes.summary: Workflow YAML and Python helpers assemble prompts, choose skill paths, validate artifacts, and apply generated output.
details: They form the execution layer that must point at the correct skill directory for each workflow.

nodes.title: Installer, tests, docs
nodes.summary: The installer propagates the template to target repos, tests defend the migration behavior, and product docs explain the directory contract.
details: These supporting surfaces keep the new boundary stable across upgrades and user-facing documentation.

tour.title: Start with local skills
tour.body: .agents/skills remains the local/shared skill catalog.

tour.title: Separate workflow-only skills
tour.body: .github/skills becomes the dedicated home for GitHub workflow-only instructions.

tour.title: Wire workflow entrypoints
tour.body: Workflows and helper scripts must read the new workflow skill paths explicitly.

tour.title: Lock the contract
tour.body: Installer behavior, tests, and product docs keep the directory split consistent.

graphs.label: Data flow graph
graphs.summary: How skill guidance flows from source directories into workflow execution and installed target repositories.

nodes.title: Source directory boundary
nodes.summary: The PR classifies skills into local/shared .agents/skills and workflow-only .github/skills.
details: This is the core data model change: skill path encodes whether a skill is local-facing or workflow-only.

nodes.title: Workflow prompts read .github/skills
nodes.summary: GitHub workflow YAML and custom agent prompts update references from .agents/skills to .github/skills.
details: This moves workflow-only instructions into explicit workflow prompt context instead of local discovery.

nodes.title: Helpers select new paths
nodes.summary: Python helpers and validators now point at .github/skills for workflow-owned review, triage, dedupe, spec, and implementation skills.
details: The implementation changes prompt preparation, output application, review skill selection, and contract validation references.

nodes.title: Installer syncs both surfaces
nodes.summary: install.sh syncs .agents/contracts, local/shared skills, workflow skills, scripts, agents, and workflows into target repositories.
details: The installer also cleans legacy workflow skills from .agents/skills and migrates allowed legacy companions when appropriate.

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: Review flagged that cleanup order could migrate repo-local companions into target .github/skills if source .agents/skills still contained stale companions.

nodes.title: Target repo receives clean layout
nodes.summary: Installed repositories receive local/shared skills under .agents/skills and workflow-only skills under .github/skills, excluding repo-local companions from upstream source trees.
details: The second commit fixes installation order and excludes *-repo companions from .agents/skills sync.

tour.title: Start with the split
tour.body: The PR first creates a clearer data boundary between local/shared and workflow-only skills.

tour.title: Workflow prompts consume the new location
tour.body: Workflow YAML and agent prompts are updated so CI reads .github/skills explicitly.

tour.title: Helper scripts follow the same path
tour.body: Python helpers and validators are updated to keep generated inputs and outputs aligned.

tour.title: Installer propagates the split
tour.body: install.sh becomes the place where existing target repositories are cleaned and upgraded.

tour.title: End with target repo layout
tour.body: The result is a cleaner installed repository with workflow skills isolated under .github/skills.

graphs.label: Code dependency graph
graphs.summary: Main implementation dependencies changed by the migration.

nodes.title: Skill tree rename
nodes.summary: Workflow-only skill directories are renamed from .agents/skills to .github/skills.
details: The diff contains many zero-content renames plus targeted path wording updates inside workflow skills.

nodes.title: Workflow YAML
nodes.summary: Workflow entrypoints update skill paths in prompts and validation steps.
details: Affected workflows include issue implementation, spec creation, PR review, triage, product docs, wiki compile, and update workflows.

nodes.title: Python helpers
nodes.summary: Helper scripts update hard-coded workflow skill paths and output boundaries.
details: These scripts prepare context, apply implementation outputs, prepare PR comments, and select review skills.

nodes.title: install.sh migration logic
nodes.summary: The installer adds .github/skills sync and legacy cleanup for target repositories.
details: The first commit introduced cleanup and sync logic; the follow-up commit moved cleanup before sync and excluded *-repo companions from local skill sync.

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: 发现 1 个需要合并前修复的问题：安装脚本在同步本地 skills 后才清理 legacy workflow skills，会把本仓库自带的 repo-local companion 误迁移进目标仓库的 .github/skills。

nodes.title: Regression tests
nodes.summary: Tests update expected paths and add coverage for stale source companion handling.
details: The important new test proves a stale source .agents/skills/*-repo companion is not installed or migrated into a target repo.

nodes.title: Product docs and wiki
nodes.summary: Raw product docs, wiki concepts, summaries, and log entries are updated to describe the new directory contract.
details: The documentation changes explain .agents/skills as local/shared and .github/skills as workflow-only.

tour.title: Start with the structural move
tour.body: Most changed files follow from moving workflow-only skills into .github/skills.

tour.title: Then follow workflow entrypoints
tour.body: Workflow prompts are the first code path that must read the new skill location.

tour.title: Helpers keep artifacts consistent
tour.body: Context preparation and output application scripts need the same path model.

tour.title: Installer is the migration hotspot
tour.body: install.sh has the most behavioral risk because it mutates target repositories.

tour.title: Tests capture the fix
tour.body: The regression test guards the review-discovered companion migration issue.

tour.title: Docs close the loop
tour.body: Product docs and wiki pages align the written contract with the implementation.

graphs.label: User action graph
graphs.summary: Reviewer and maintainer path through the PR.

nodes.title: Reviewer opens a large migration PR
nodes.summary: The reviewer sees many path rewrites and renames across skills, workflows, scripts, tests, and docs.
details: The quickest orientation is to group files by boundary: skill tree move, workflow wiring, installer migration, tests, and docs.

nodes.title: Reviewer checks installer safety
nodes.summary: The behavioral risk is target repository mutation during install or upgrade.
details: The existing review comment identified cleanup order and stale repo-local companion handling as the key issue.

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: Cleanup after syncing local skills could migrate stale repo-local companions into target .github/skills.

nodes.title: Author applies follow-up fix
nodes.summary: A second commit changes installer order and adds a focused regression test.
details: The PR discussion records that requested changes were applied on refactor/split-local-workflow-skills-266.

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body: Applied requested changes: clean or migrate legacy workflow/companion skills before syncing current .agents/skills, exclude *-repo companions, and add install script regression coverage.

nodes.title: Maintainer validates broad surface
nodes.summary: Validation spans install tests, full workflow/script tests, py_compile, diff whitespace checks, and local PR review.
details: The PR body reports unittest coverage for install script and aicodingflow tests, py_compile across helper scripts, git diff --check, and $review-pr-local.

nodes.title: Reader sees the new boundary
nodes.summary: The visible result is a clear rule: local/shared skills stay in .agents/skills; workflow-only skills live in .github/skills.
details: No PR-changed specs were identified; intent is carried by PR body, code changes, tests, docs, and review discussion.

tour.title: Open the PR by grouping files
tour.body: Do not read the changed file list linearly; group it into migration surfaces.

tour.title: Prioritize installer behavior
tour.body: The installer has the highest behavioral blast radius because it changes target repositories.

tour.title: Follow the feedback fix
tour.body: The second commit and issue comment show how the review concern was addressed.

tour.title: Check validation breadth
tour.body: The validation set is broad because the PR touches workflows, scripts, docs, and install behavior.

tour.title: End at the new rule
tour.body: The reviewer should leave with one clean boundary: local/shared under .agents, workflow-only under .github.
